description: Live 3D snapshot of a pump.fun / Solana token. Composes on-chain token metadata, bonding-curve graduation progress, and top-holder distribution, and returns a shareable three.ws /coin3d viewer deep-link (a spinning coin medallion textured with the token logo, a holder galaxy, and a graduation ring) plus an embeddable iframe and the underlying data. Read-only, free. Use this to hand a user a visual, shareable view of a coin; for the raw numbers alone call get_token_details and get_token_holders.
name: pumpfun_token_3d
title: Token 3D Snapshot
